areas.name: Silom
areas.summary: Tagsüber Finanzviertel, abends eines der wichtigsten Ausgehviertel Bangkoks mit Patpong.

nightlife.why: Hauptpartyviertel der Stadt bei Nacht – „but Bangkok's primary party district by night when quarters like the infamous Patpong come alive.“

budget.why: Überwiegend teure Hotels – „Most of the hotels in Silom are four- or five-star hotels catering to business travellers.“

transit.why: Fußweg zur BTS Sala Daeng, Patpong ist nah – „It's a short walk from BTS Sala Daeng station, deserted by day but jam-packed and overflowing in all directions by night.“

areas.name: Khao San Road
areas.summary: Backpacker-Zentrum mit den günstigsten Unterkünften und lebhaften Straßenbars in Bangkok.

nightlife.why: Viele günstige Straßenbars – „Khao San Road has some of the cheapest bars in town, and these days even Thais head down to knock back a few.“

quiet.why: Nachts sehr laut – „Accommodation directly on Khao San Road can be noisy late into the night due to bars and street activity.“

budget.why: Günstigste Unterkünfte der Stadt – „Most backpackers head straight for Khao San Road as it has the cheapest accommodation in all of Bangkok.“

safety.why: Viele Betrugsmaschen – „Khao San Road is the worst district in Bangkok when it comes to scams and annoyances.“

transit.why: Nur Busse als praktischer Nahverkehr – „for those staying in Khao San Road where buses are the only practical means of public transport“

areas.name: Sukhumvit
areas.summary: Gehobenes Viertel mit Hotels, Restaurants und Clubs, gut an die Skytrain angebunden.
watchOut: Go-go-Bars in Nana und Soi Cowboy

nightlife.why: Unzählige Bars und Clubs – „The Sukhumvit area contains more watering holes than can easily be counted, and touts are not as big of a problem here as in Patpong.“

food.why: Riesige Auswahl von Luxus bis Straßenstand – „Sukhumvit offers the best dining in Bangkok, from five-star dining to street stands, the variety of choices and tastes are almost overwhelming.“

budget.why: Unterkünfte sind teuer – „Property values in Sukhumvit are among the highest in Bangkok, and accommodation is priced to match.“

safety.why: Weniger Schlepper als in Patpong – „and touts are not as big of a problem here as in Patpong.“

transit.why: Skytrain verläuft entlang der Straße – „It is filled with quality hotels, restaurants and nightclubs and has the famous BTS Skytrain running along it.“

areas.name: Siam Square
areas.summary: Bangkoks modernes Einkaufszentrum mit Malls, Boutiquen und dem zentralen Skytrain-Knoten.

nightlife.why: Kaum Nachtleben – „Siam Square is not that well known for its nightlife, as shops tend to close about 22:00 and the area gets pretty silent afterwards.“

quiet.why: Nach 22 Uhr recht still – „Siam Square is not that well known for its nightlife, as shops tend to close about 22:00 and the area gets pretty silent afterwards.“

food.why: Viele kleine Restaurants und Cafés – „filled with hundreds of tiny boutiques, restaurants, cafés, record stores and bookshops“

transit.why: Skytrain-Knoten als Zentrum – „The Skytrain intersection at Siam Square is the closest thing Bangkok has to a centre.“

areas.name: Rattanakosin
areas.summary: Historische Altstadt mit Großem Palast und Wat Pho, Banglamphu als nordwestlicher Rand.

nightlife.why: Nachtleben vor allem in Banglamphu – „The Banglamphu area on the western edge, including Khao San Road and Rambuttri, is known for budget accommodation and nightlife.“

quiet.why: Abends ruhiger am Fluss und in Seitenstraßen – „from lively around Khao San Road to noticeably quieter and more residential along the river and smaller inner streets“

transit.why: Express-Boot verbindet die Sehenswürdigkeiten – „most foreign visitors use the express boat to hop from place to place“

areas.name: Yaowarat
areas.summary: Chinesisches Viertel mit Streetfood, Märkten und abends beleuchteten Straßen.
watchOut: Die meisten Läden schließen um 17 Uhr

nightlife.why: Abends belebte Straßen mit Restaurants – „But at night, the neon signs blazing with Chinese characters are turned on and crowds from the restaurants spill out onto the streets“

food.why: Günstige, besondere Speisen – „A visit to the area is not complete without having some of its amazing delicacies that sell for an absolute bargain“

budget.why: Essen ist sehr günstig – „A visit to the area is not complete without having some of its amazing delicacies that sell for an absolute bargain“

safety.why: Abseits der typischen Touristenmaschen – „As Yaowarat and Phahurat are remarkably off the traditional tourist track, there is less to worry about than elsewhere in the city.“

areas.name: Dusit
areas.summary: Grünes, europäisch angelegtes Regierungsviertel mit Palästen und breiten Alleen.

nightlife.why: Kein Nachtleben – „Don't expect any nightlife in Dusit.“

quiet.why: Viel Verkehr auf breiten Alleen – „Dusit's wide avenues and heavy traffic make it a less than compelling places to stay the night.“

nature.why: Üppige Gärten und Alleen – „Its breezy palaces, lush gardens and broad avenues give this district its distinct character.“

areas.name: Thonburi
areas.summary: Ruhiges Westufer des Chao Phraya mit Kanälen, Orchards und Bootstouren.

nightlife.why: Kaum Nachtleben – „Do not expect much of a nightlife scene in Thonburi“

quiet.why: Kühle, friedliche Atmosphäre – „most visitors still come here for the cool and peaceful atmosphere“

transit.why: Schwer erreichbar ohne Bootstour – „Thonburi is a vast district, and getting around it is not easy.“

nature.why: Kanäle und Obstgärten – „The traditional Thai way of life on the canals still exists here, as do the floating vendors and orchard farms.“

areas.name: Pratunam
areas.summary: Großes Großhandels-Modemarkt-Viertel mit Baiyoke Tower II und Victory Monument.

nightlife.why: Nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit leer – „Pratunam quickly becomes deserted after dark, unless you're visiting the Rooftop Bar (as described in the See section).“

budget.why: Unterkünfte eher teuer – „While the shopping is one of the cheapest in Bangkok, accommodation tends to be in the splurge category.“

areas.name: Chatuchak
areas.summary: Wochenend-Großmarkt mit über 8.000 Ständen im nördlichen Bangkok.

transit.why: Skytrain-Linie hält am Markt – „The Sukhumvit Line passes Victory Monument and Chatuchak Weekend Market.“

areas.name: Ratchadaphisek
areas.summary: Unterhaltungsmeile der Einheimischen mit Clubs, Karaoke und der RCA.

transit.why: U-Bahn verläuft darunter – „It is the transportation hub of the district as the MRT metro runs right beneath it.“

areas.name: Bang Kapi
areas.summary: Lebhaftes Viertel im Osten mit Einkaufszentren und Studenten, erreichbar mit dem Saen-Saep-Boot.

food.why: Restaurants für Pendler und Studenten – „These are lively areas with shopping malls and restaurants that cater to commuters and university students.“

transit.why: Saen-Saep-Boot fährt hindurch – „the Saen Saep Express Boat runs right through them“
